cases.name: credentials-lifecycle
cases.tradeoff: Credentials syntax counts only inside a real multi-stage pipeline summary with post lifecycle; validity and execution remain unverified.

cases.name: parallel-shared-library
cases.tradeoff: Existing static L3 alternative preserves a real declarative pipeline with parallel orchestration and shared library.

cases.name: credential-keywords-in-string
cases.tradeoff: Quoted keywords do not form a pipeline or credentials binding.

cases.name: one-stage-credentials
cases.tradeoff: Credentials in a one-stage pipeline without post lifecycle remain below L3.

cases.name: test-only-pipeline
cases.tradeoff: A structurally deep pipeline under a test fixture path is retained as lower evidence but cannot support an L3 production-pipeline claim.
